metaDescription: Order custom cotton cord plastic vinyl products in bulk. Perfect for branding with your logo. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Cotton cord adds a natural, tactile accent to plastic vinyl drinkware, giving tumblers and mugs a handcrafted feel that stands out in trade show swag or corporate gift sets. Unlike standard plastic items, the cotton cord wrap offers a comfortable grip and a subtle textural contrast that recipients appreciate. Whether you choose a 20 oz Double Wall Plastic Tumbler or a 16 oz Roadster Mug, the cord detail makes your logo feel integrated rather than stuck on. Popular decoration methods include screen printing and debossing directly on the cord or using a hang tag tied to the cord for a clean, custom look that reinforces your brand message.
heroAltText: Custom cotton cord plastic vinyl tumbler with a wrapped handle, featuring a debossed logo on the cord for branding
